title: Networking Basics
reason: Cisco-authored networking foundation with self-paced study, hands-on practice, assessments and a digital badge.
notes: Discovery evidence indicates roughly 22 hours and no required physical equipment; exact language catalogue should be normalised during shallow review.

title: Networking Devices and Initial Configuration
reason: Practical Cisco pathway on device configuration and network operation with labs, quizzes, final assessment and badge recognition.

title: Operating Systems Basics
reason: Self-paced operating-systems foundation with practical labs and assessment, suitable preparation for broader IT and cybersecurity study.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
language_notes: Cisco exposes multiple localised versions; Portuguese variants must remain explicitly pt-PT or pt-BR only when the individual course locale is verified.
reason: Accessible six-hour cybersecurity introduction with practice labs, interactive activities, quizzes, a final exam and digital badge.

title: Endpoint Security
reason: Career-oriented endpoint-security course from Cisco combining defensive concepts with practical technician-level security skills and assessment.

title: Network Defense
reason: Free Cisco network-defense course aimed at building practical defensive-security capability and progressing toward cybersecurity careers.

title: Cyber Threat Management
reason: Structured threat-management course with labs, interactive activities, quizzes, a final exam and a digital badge aligned to entry-level cyber skills.

title: Ethical Hacker
reason: Substantial offensive-security pathway with real-world-inspired labs, extensive practice, final exam, skills-based assessment and a digital badge.
notes: Cisco course documentation describes about 70 hours, 34 labs and prerequisite entry-level cybersecurity knowledge.

title: Fortinet Networking Fundamentals
reason: Free self-paced vendor-neutral networking foundation covering LANs, OSI, TCP/IP, devices, internetworking, virtualisation and cloud concepts.
notes: The course page states that this course has no certification exam; Fortinet optional labs and certification products are evaluated separately from free lecture access.

title: FortiGate Operator
reason: Current FortiOS 7.6 self-paced operations course using demos and interactive simulations across firewalling, VPN, filtering, IPS and maintenance.
notes: The associated exam awards a badge; shallow review must verify whether that exam remains free before upgrading this candidate to F0.

title: Introduction to Data Science
reason: Free Cisco introduction to the data-science field with structured self-paced learning, assessments and digital badge recognition.

title: Data Analytics Essentials
reason: Applied data-analytics pathway from Cisco designed around practical analysis skills, self-paced study and completion recognition.
notes: The course has appeared under both /courses and /trainings routes; canonical URL stability must be confirmed during shallow review.

title: Pandas
reason: Compact hands-on Pandas course using executable notebook exercises and the same no-cost completion-certificate model as Kaggle Learn.

title: Data Visualization
reason: Four-hour applied visualisation course with coding exercises, chart-selection practice, a final project and a no-cost certificate.

title: Intro to SQL
reason: Three-hour SQL introduction using BigQuery with tutorials, executable exercises and a no-cost Kaggle completion certificate.

title: Advanced SQL
reason: Hands-on continuation covering joins, analytic functions, nested data and efficient queries with exercises and a no-cost certificate.

title: Intermediate Machine Learning
reason: Practical four-hour ML course on missing data, categorical variables, pipelines, cross-validation, XGBoost and data leakage with exercises and certificate.

title: Statistics 110: Probability
reason: Highly regarded probability course with full lecture sequence, extensive problem material, practice resources and a freely available companion book.

title: 18.650 Statistics for Applications
reason: Rigorous MIT statistics course with lecture videos, slides and assignments focused on mathematical foundations and real-world statistical problem formulation.

title: BUS205: Business Law
reason: Thirty-nine-hour business-law course covering contracts, torts, property, intellectual property and employment law with a free final exam and certificate.
notes: Optional ACE credit uses separate paid proctoring and must not be confused with the free completion certificate.

title: DL-101 General Course on Intellectual Property (version 2)
reason: Fifty-five-hour WIPO intellectual-property course that is explicitly free of charge and includes a formal completion certificate and exam.
notes: Runs in scheduled sessions rather than permanent rolling access; registration windows must be tracked by maintenance checks.

title: IP Panorama 2.0
reason: Twenty-hour free open-access WIPO course using interactive micro-learning and real-world cases to teach intellectual-property strategy for business.
notes: The 2026 catalogue explicitly lists no certificate; shallow review should verify the extent of embedded assessment before final F1/F2 classification.

title: HELP Self-Learning Courses
language_notes: The HELP catalogue contains hundreds of national language versions; language availability must be recorded at individual-course level if courses are later split out.
reason: Public self-paced human-rights and legal-professional learning catalogue with unlimited access and individualised digital statements of accomplishment.
notes: This is an umbrella learning experience rather than one course; deep review should decide whether to retain the catalogue or replace it with selected HELP courses.

title: The Scottish Parliament and law making
reason: Eight-week badged course on legislation, devolution, constitutional structure and public participation in law-making, with quizzes and free participation recognition.
notes: Updated in 2020 and jurisdiction-specific; currency and transferability should be weighed in deep review.

title: Legal skills and debates in Scotland
reason: Twenty-four-hour badged legal-skills course combining legislation, judgments, interpretation, argument, precedent, human rights, problem solving and legal writing.
notes: CPD-recognised but last updated in 2020; comparative currency review is required.

title: Take your teaching online
reason: Eight-week university-authored course on effective, inclusive and accessible online teaching with quizzes, a free statement and digital badge.

title: Inclusive education: knowing what we mean (Wales)
reason: Focused introduction to competing models and principles of inclusive education with activities and free OpenLearn completion recognition.
notes: Welsh context is explicit; deep review should judge international transferability.

title: TeachingEnglish: How to adapt resources
reason: Current free 9–12 hour teacher-development course with self-study modules, practical resource adaptation and a certificate of achievement.
notes: Current run is listed from April 2026 through March 2027; maintenance must track annual availability windows.

title: TeachingEnglish: Helping teachers to learn
reason: Free certificate-bearing teacher-educator course on training sessions, communities of practice, collaboration and self-directed professional learning.
notes: Current run is listed through March 2027.

title: TeachingEnglish: Communicative tasks
reason: Current 9–12 hour free course on genre, communicative speaking/listening and task-based learning with workbook and free completion certificate.
notes: Enrolment for the current run closes 23 September 2026 and the course ends 30 September 2026, so it requires rapid re-verification.

title: BIO101: Introduction to Molecular and Cellular Biology
reason: Thirty-six-hour biology course on molecular and cellular foundations with free enrolment, assessments, final exam and course-completion certificate.
notes: Optional ACE credit is separate and may involve a paid proctored exam.

title: CHEM101: General Chemistry
reason: Seventy-three-hour general-chemistry curriculum progressing from atomic structure to matter and reactions with a free certificate and structured assessment.

title: Open Science 101
reason: Public five-module NASA course on practical, ethical and reproducible open-science practice with self-paced access, digital badge and certificate.
notes: Cross-disciplinary scientific-practice course rather than a single natural-science subject; taxonomy fit should be reviewed before v1.0.

title: AP®︎/College Biology
reason: Mastery-based biology curriculum with videos, articles, simulations, quizzes, unit tests and course challenge across biochemistry, genetics, evolution and ecology.

title: AP®︎/College Chemistry
reason: Comprehensive mastery-enabled chemistry curriculum with nine units, extensive skills practice, quizzes, unit tests and a course challenge.

title: Getting started in design
reason: Free self-paced digital-design curriculum spanning research, ethics, accessibility, UI, grids, colour, prototyping and design systems with hands-on design exercises.
notes: Exercises use Figma's free tier; no formal certificate was observed at discovery.

title: Pixar in a Box
reason: Project-rich animation learning experience connecting storytelling, modelling, rigging, lighting, simulation, colour, cameras and rendering with mathematics and science.

title: CS 178: Digital Photography
reason: Deep photography curriculum integrating optics, cameras, image processing, computational photography, visual history and practical photographic assignments.
notes: Not a current MOOC; public lecture material exists, but some legacy Flash applets are obsolete. Strong content signal but significant usability/currency risk.

title: Marugoto A1-1 (Katsudoo & Rikai) Self-Study Course
language_notes: This entry uses the English-explanation edition; a French-explanation version is also available and should be represented as an alternate version rather than a separate ranked course.
reason: Free 48-hour integrated A1 Japanese course covering reading, listening, writing and speaking with progress tracking, assignments and tests.
notes: Anytime registration with six months of access from course start; no completion credential was confirmed during discovery.

title: Première classe
reason: Large free beginner pathway built around authentic video, with hundreds of interactive exercises on everyday French inside a broader A1–B2 learning platform.
notes: Discovery page lists roughly 480 Première classe exercises and more than 4,000 exercises across the full TV5MONDE platform; no formal certificate observed.

title: Nicos Weg (A1–B1)
language_notes: The learning interface and explanations are available in multiple languages; exact supported-language list should be verified directly during shallow review.
reason: Story-driven German pathway spanning CEFR A1 to B1 with video, grammar, vocabulary and extensive interactive exercises and tests.
notes: No free formal certificate was confirmed during discovery; direct DW pages can be difficult for automated crawlers, so availability should be checked manually during shallow review.
